claim_boundary: This union schema contract, its field mapping and its synthetic fixtures are a schema-level alignment artifact only. No live cutover, no BACH runtime change, no task-master runtime change, no BACH-IN, no migration, no rollback, and no parity acceptance is performed or implied.

hold.rule: Do not modify, push, boot, or wire BACH or task-master into a live union during the active hold. Source inspection is static only; fixtures are synthetic and temporary.

bach.inspection: AST plus SHA-256; no import or runtime boot

task_master.inspection: AST plus SHA-256 of taskplan/transit; no import or runtime boot

identity.bach_id: Integer local backlog id; never transited as union identity.
identity.union_identity: task_uid (uuid4) plus logical_task_id (sha256) identify the union row.
identity.logical_task_id_computation: compute_logical_task_id(scope_id, project_id, source_kind, source_locator, fingerprint, source_revision, contract_version) in taskplan/transit/models.py.
identity.migration_id: mig:<task_id>:<ltid> idempotent commit marker with dry-run projection and crash-before-commit simulation.
identity.working_memory: BACH working memory stores only logical_task_id and task_uid pointers, never union payload copies.

pending.notes: A new BACH backlog task projects to an open rinnsal_tasks row plus an append-only task_created event.

in_progress.notes: assigned_to maps to the claim/lease holder only after claim_granted; no autonomous claim when transit_scope is central.

done.notes: completion_comment is carried as completed-event payload; the union row becomes terminal and later mutation is refused.

blocked.notes: blocked has no taskplan transit event kind; it stays a BACH-local projection flag and must not be forced into the union event log.

deferred.notes: deferred round-trips through the deferred event kind; a later reopen returns the task to open.

field_mapping.priority: BACH-local ordering field; no rinnsal_tasks column; stays in the BACH projection and is never transited.
field_mapping.depends_on: BACH-local dependency list; the union schema does not transit edges; dependency order remains a BACH projection concern.
field_mapping.history: BACH history entries project to append-only taskplan_transit_events rows; the union event log is never rewritten.

terminal_rules.rule: Mutations on terminal rows fail closed; identity or terminal conflicts set identity_collision or terminal_conflict and project to tombstoned.
terminal_rules.tombstone: Tombstoned rows remain append-only history; no resurrection.

scope_guard.central: scope=central tasks are never claimed or mutated autonomously.
scope_guard.fail_closed: Empty or local:* transit_scope fails closed for shared claims; shared scope requires the registry; an uncertain clock pauses claims.

field_mapping.claim_race_protection: Only LEAD TRITHON holds the claim salt; claims serialize through claim_requested then claim_granted, which closes the race window between parallel backlog writers.

fixtures.privacy: Synthetic task ids, titles, actors, scopes, and timestamps only; no BACH database, paths, logs, tokens, personal records, or real task content.

classification.union-direct: The union mechanism matches the BACH backlog semantic directly, but parity is still not accepted.
classification.adapter-required: The union supplies related mechanics; BACH-specific projection, output, or lifecycle behavior remains in a future thin adapter.
classification.bach-local-only: The field or status exists only in the BACH backlog and must not be forced into taskplan transit.
classification.guard-fail-closed: Policy or selector gate refuses autonomous handling; manual review is required.

backlog.semantic_domain: BACH task backlog lifecycle projection onto taskplan rinnsal transit
state_owners: claim salt held exclusively by LEAD TRITHON

operations.name: create
operations.source_effect: Insert a BACH backlog row with status pending and append a history entry.
operations.remaining_difference: Backlog id is local only; union identity (task_uid, logical_task_id) is computed from scope, project, and fingerprint pins.

operations.name: claim
operations.source_effect: Set status in_progress and record assigned_to.
operations.union_surface: claim_requested then claim_granted events; lease on the rinnsal row
operations.remaining_difference: scope=central plus identity or terminal conflicts refuse autonomous claims; an uncertain clock pauses them.

operations.name: complete
operations.source_effect: Set status done and record completion_comment.
operations.remaining_difference: completion_comment is event payload, not a union column; terminal rows refuse later mutation.

operations.name: defer
operations.remaining_difference: Round-trip and due handling stay BACH-local.

operations.name: block
operations.remaining_difference: No taskplan transit event kind carries blocked; it must remain a BACH-local projection flag.

operations.name: history
operations.remaining_difference: Backlog history ordering and wording differ; the union log is append-only and authoritative.

next_gates: Keep tools/check_task_union_contract.py as a required regression gate and stop on BACH or task-master pin drift.
Keep the union contract free of any live cutover, runtime wiring, migration, or parity acceptance until explicit review.
After the hold, run one anonymized backlog fixture through both projections and compare allowed state changes.
Only then design BACH-IN task-union adapters, rollback guards, and the scope=central manual-claim workflow.
Keep the claim salt exclusively with LEAD TRITHON; any additional claim authority is a separate reviewed change.
